regime: Split — SPX Neutral Bull / NDX Bullish / RUT Bearish / DJI Bearish
summary: Mega-cap chips and a SanDisk-led memory bid held SPX (+0.17%) and NDX (+0.67%) green while breadth imploded (SPX 155 adv/344 dec, 143 new lows vs 16 highs) under the post-FOMC rising-rate regime — RUT (-0.50%) and DJI (-0.18%) both Bearish. Memory/storage names (SNDK +10.99%, WDC, STX, MU, MRVL, LITE) rallied on S&P 100 index inclusion effective 21 Sep, tightening NAND spot pricing on the Nvidia Vera-Rubin ramp, and SanDisk's investor-day margin thesis; semicap was an oversold bounce, not accumulation. Crypto ripped risk-on (ETHA +7.85%, IBIT +6.28%); WTI crashed -5.63% as Iran halted strikes. Structural RS leadership remains defensive biotech/pharma.
